```{r}

```
  The RNA-seq data contains 4 conditions: Ep-low, Ep-high, Ep-low-IFNg (10ng/mL for 24hr), or Ep-low-IFNg. With 3 repliates each.
  First, RNA-seq reads were quantified using Salmon/1.8.0. 
  Transcriptome version: GRCm39, Esembl 108
1. We will import count files using tximport, and perform alignment QC using STAR + Qualimap.
```{r}
# Load metadata and tx2gene file
dir <- "~/Dropbox (Partners HealthCare)/BPPNM RNA-seq/results"
dira <- "~/Dropbox (Partners HealthCare)/BPPNM RNA-seq/Analysis"
meta <- read.table(file.path(dira,"BPPNM_EMT_meta.csv"), sep=",",header=T)
meta$Condition <- factor(meta$Condition)
meta$EMT <- factor(meta$EMT)
txdb <- makeTxDbFromEnsembl(organism="Mus musculus", release=108)
k <- keys(txdb, keytype="TXNAME")
tx2gene <- select(txdb, k, "GENEID", "TXNAME")
# Load Salmon output using tximport
files <- file.path(dir,paste("salmon/",meta$Sample,"_salmon", sep=""),"quant.sf")
txi_data <- tximport(files, type="salmon",tx2gene=tx2gene, ignoreTxVersion = T)
```
2. Make DEseq dataset
```{r}
names(txi_data)
head(txi_data$counts)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi_data, colData = meta, design = ~Condition)
colnames(dds) <- meta$Sample
dds
```

```{r}
# Data QC, remove genes with low counts

dds <- dds[keep,]

# RNA
genenames <- select(org.Mm.eg.db, keys= keys(org.Mm.eg.db, keytype="ENSEMBL"), columns=c("SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL"), keytype="ENSEMBL")
resfiles <- list(res.Ep_Ctrl,res.Ep_IFNg,res.Ephigh_Stim,res.Eplow_Stim)

               "Ephigh_IFNg_vs_Ephigh_Ctrl.deseq2_output.tsv", "Eplow_IFNg_vs_Eplow_Ctrl.deseq2_output.tsv")
plotnames <- c("Eplow_Ctrl_vs_Ephigh_Ctrl", "Eplow_IFNg_vs_Ephigh_IFNg",
               "Ephigh_IFNg_vs_Ephigh_Ctrl", "Eplow_IFNg_vs_Eplow_Ctrl")
for (i in 1:4){
  resp_table <- merge(as.data.frame(resfiles[i]), genenames, by.x=0, by.y="ENSEMBL")
  resp_table <- resp_table[!duplicated(resp_table$SYMBOL),]
  resp_table <- resp_table %>%  remove_rownames() %>% column_to_rownames(var = "SYMBOL")
  resp_table <- resp_table[order(resp_table$padj), ]
  #p1 <- EnhancedVolcano(resp_table, lab=rownames(resp_table), x="log2FoldChange", y="padj", title= plotnames[i], xlim = c(-8,8), pointSize = 1, pCutoff=10e-5, FCcutoff=1, labSize=4)
  #print(p1)
  #write.table(resp_table, file=file.path(dir, "DEseq2",filenames[i]), sep='\t', row.names=T)
  resSig <- subset(resp_table, padj < 0.1 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.5)
  resSig <- resSig[order(resSig$log2FoldChange),]
  print(str(sum(resSig$log2FoldChange < 0)), str(sum(resSig$log2FoldChange > 0)))
  write.table(resSig, file=paste(dir, "/DEseq2/",plotnames[i],".deseq2_significant.tsv",sep=""), sep='\t', row.names=T)
}

# For each subset, calculate which ones are differentially expressed in the correct direction, with delta_LFC > 0.25

emt_ifng_down <- emt_IFNg[rownames(emt_IFNg) %in% emt_ifng_only & emt_IFNg$log2FoldChange < -0.5,]
emt_ifng_up <- subset(emt_ifng_up, select =-c(Row.names))
emt_ifng_upcompare <- merge(emt_ifng_up, emt_Ctrl_all["log2FoldChange"], by=0)
emt_ifng_upcompare <- emt_ifng_upcompare[(emt_ifng_upcompare$log2FoldChange.x-emt_ifng_upcompare$log2FoldChange.y)>0.25,]
emt_ifng_down <- subset(emt_ifng_down, select =-c(Row.names))
emt_ifng_downcompare <- merge(emt_ifng_down, emt_Ctrl_all["log2FoldChange"], by=0)
emt_ifng_downcompare <- emt_ifng_downcompare[(emt_ifng_downcompare$log2FoldChange.x-emt_ifng_downcompare$log2FoldChange.y) < (-0.25),]
emt_ifng_exposurepost <- emt_IFNg[rownames(emt_IFNg) %in% union(emt_ifng_upcompare$Row.names, emt_ifng_downcompare$Row.names),]

# Convert Ensembl to mouse gene symbols
mensembl_mgi_zscores <- function(dds){
  vsd <- vst(dds, blind=F)
  counts <- as.data.frame(assay(vsd))
  gns <- rownames(counts)
  genenames <- select(org.Mm.eg.db, keys= gns, columns=c("SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL"), keytype="ENSEMBL")
  norm_genes <- merge(genenames, counts, by.x="ENSEMBL", by.y=0)
  norm_genes <- norm_genes[!duplicated(norm_genes$SYMBOL) & !is.na(norm_genes$SYMBOL),]
  norm_genes <- norm_genes %>%  remove_rownames() %>% column_to_rownames(var = "SYMBOL")
  norm_genes <- norm_genes[-c(1)]
  means <- rowMeans(norm_genes)
  sds <- apply(norm_genes, 1, sd)
  heatmap_zscore <- (norm_genes-means)/sds # Z-score normalized gene expression
  return(heatmap_zscore)
}
norm_genes <- mensembl_mgi_zscores(dds)
gsea_top10 <- norm_genes[rownames(norm_genes) %in% emt_genes,]
pheatmap(gsea_top10[c(4:6,10:12)])
```

5. Prep for GSEA
```{r}
norm_counts <- as.data.frame(counts(dds, normalized = T))
fun <- function(gns){
    egs <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, gns, "ENTREZID","ENSEMBL")
    mapped <- select(Orthology.eg.db, egs, "Homo.sapiens","Mus.musculus")
    mapped$HS <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, as.character(mapped$Homo.sapiens), "SYMBOL", "ENTREZID")
    mapped <- mapped[!is.na(mapped$Homo.sapiens) & !duplicated(mapped$HS),]
    return(mapped)
}
gene_df <- fun(rownames(norm_counts))
norm_genes <- merge(gene_df["HS"], norm_counts, by=0)
# Do column to rownames and remove ENSEMBL column
norm_genes <- norm_genes %>%  remove_rownames() %>% column_to_rownames(var = "HS")
colnames(norm_genes)[1] <- "DESCRIPTION"
norm_genes$DESCRIPTION = "na"
write.table(norm_genes, file=file.path(dira, "norm_counts.txt"),sep="\t")
```

get_genes <- function(mes, epi, dir){
  genes <- c()
  for (p in mes$NAME[1:3]){
    print(p)
    p_file <- read.csv(paste(dir, "/",p,".tsv", sep=""), sep="\t")
    ngenes <- p_file$SYMBOL[1:10]
    genes <- c(genes,ngenes)
  }
  for (p in epi$NAME[1:3]){
    print(p)
    p_file <- read.csv(paste(dir, "/",p,".tsv", sep=""), sep="\t")
    nrows <- dim(p_file)[1]
    ngenes <- p_file$SYMBOL[(nrows-9):nrows]
    genes <- c(genes,ngenes)
    }
  return(genes)
}
genes <- get_genes(mes_ifng,mes_ifng, diri)
# Normalize genes and plot heatmap

mensembl_hgnc_zscores <- function(counts){
  gns <- rownames(counts)
  egs <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, gns, "ENTREZID","ENSEMBL")
  mapped <- select(Orthology.eg.db, egs, "Homo.sapiens","Mus.musculus")
  mapped$HS <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, as.character(mapped$Homo.sapiens), "SYMBOL", "ENTREZID")
  mapped <- mapped[!is.na(mapped$Homo.sapiens) & !duplicated(mapped$HS),]
  norm_genes <- merge(mapped["HS"], counts, by=0)
  norm_genes <- norm_genes %>%  remove_rownames() %>% column_to_rownames(var = "HS")
  norm_genes <- norm_genes[-c(1)]
  means <- rowMeans(norm_genes)
  sds <- apply(norm_genes, 1, sd)
  heatmap_zscore <- (norm_genes-means)/sds # Z-score normalized gene expression
  return(heatmap_zscore)
}
vsd <- vst(dds, blind=F)
count <- as.data.frame(assay(vsd))
norm_genes <- mensembl_hgnc_zscores(count)
gsea_top10 <- norm_genes[rownames(norm_genes) %in% emt_genes,]
pheatmap(gsea_top10)

get_genes <- function(mes, epi, dir){
  genes <- c()
  for (p in mes$NAME[1:3]){
    print(p)
    p_file <- read.csv(paste(dir, "/",p,".tsv", sep=""), sep="\t")
    ngenes <- p_file$SYMBOL[1:10]
    genes <- c(genes,ngenes)
  }
  for (p in epi$NAME[c(1:3)]){
    print(p)
    p_file <- read.csv(paste(dir, "/",p,".tsv", sep=""), sep="\t")
    nrows <- dim(p_file)[1]
    ngenes <- p_file$SYMBOL[(nrows-9):nrows]
    genes <- c(genes,ngenes)
    }
  return(genes)
}
genes <- get_genes(mes_ifng, epi_ifng, dir)

  egs <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, gns, "ENTREZID","ENSEMBL")
  mapped <- select(Orthology.eg.db, egs, "Homo.sapiens","Mus.musculus")
  mapped$HS <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, as.character(mapped$Homo.sapiens), "SYMBOL", "ENTREZID")
  mapped <- mapped[!is.na(mapped$Homo.sapiens) & !duplicated(mapped$HS),]
  norm_genes <- merge(mapped["HS"], counts, by=0)
  norm_genes <- norm_genes %>%  remove_rownames() %>% column_to_rownames(var = "HS")
  norm_genes <- norm_genes[-c(1)]
  means <- rowMeans(norm_genes)
  sds <- apply(norm_genes, 1, sd)
  heatmap_zscore <- (norm_genes-means)/sds # Z-score normalized gene expression
  return(heatmap_zscore)
}
dds <- readRDS(file.path(dira, "BPPNM_EMT_deseq2.rds"))
